title: Deep learning detects cytomegalovirus in GI biopsies using IHC-validated ground truth
summary: A convolutional neural network (the no-code EasyPath platform) was trained on 120 CMV-infected cases using H&E decolorization and IHC restaining for cell-for-cell ground truth. On an independent validation cohort of 100 whole-slide images it reached overall sensitivity of 94.3% and specificity of 80.0%, with 100% sensitivity in high-burden cases and 80% in low-burden cases. The validation set is small and the specificity moderate; this is a version 1 preprint.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network built on the EasyPath no-code platform to detect CMV inclusions on H&E whole-slide images

evidence.tested: Independent validation cohort of 100 whole-slide images against IHC-derived ground truth.
evidence.unknown: Multi-site performance, effect on pathologist workflow and false-positive burden; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Finds sparse or atypical CMV inclusions in H&E slides.
